_: Copy this to ai-settings.json and put your key in it. That file is gitignored; this one is the shape, with no key in it.
_mcp_servers: Tool (MCP) servers are not set here: a project may ship an ai-settings.json, and a command in it would be a program started by opening a graph. They live in this machine's settings file (~/.tell-and-wire/settings.json, or the file TW_SETTINGS names), where an AI node's Add MCP server writes the ones that come with Tell & Wire (mcp/). See mcp/README.md.
_context_tokens: Optional: how many tokens the model above takes in at once, as a chat block's counter counts against. Anthropic and Google say it themselves; for any other provider it is guessed (128000) until you set it: "context_tokens": 128000
_writing_ai: Optional: a second model for writing -- the ✨ buttons and the bar under the canvas. Left out, the AI above writes too. Example: "writing_ai": {"provider": "google", "model": "gemini-pro-latest"}
_providers: google | openai | anthropic | ollama | lmstudio | openai_compatible | github_copilot
_keys: google -> aistudio.google.com/apikey (free tier) | openai -> OPENAI_API_KEY | anthropic -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
